title: A Deal with Medusa
summary: Queen Medusa takes over the python's body and faces Yun Shan, who sees she has also become a Dou Zong. Unwilling to risk the fight, Yun Shan lets Xiao Yan go, warning him never to return. Yun Leng proposes seizing Xiao Yan's father instead. Hai Bodong heads back to the Mite'er family and asks Xiao Yan to deliver the Spiritual Recovery Purple Pill to the capital later. Ling Ying leaves, telling Xiao Yan to grow strong enough to choose the one he loves. Medusa agrees to protect Xiao Yan for one year, only when his life is at stake, in return for the Thawing Spirit Pill. On the road to Wu Tan City she makes him hunt herbs in markets and auctions and her temper frightens the townspeople and shopkeepers.
events: Medusa appears; Yun Shan notes she has reached Dou Zong.
Yun Shan lets Xiao Yan leave, but only this once.
Yun Leng suggests bringing Xiao Zhan from Wu Tan City; Nalan Yanran weeps to Yun Yun.
Hai Bodong parts ways and warns Xiao Yan to be wary of Medusa.
Ling Ying leaves with advice about strength and love.
Medusa and Xiao Yan make a one-year deal for the Thawing Spirit Pill.
They search towns and auctions for herbs; Medusa causes trouble in a shoe shop.
